articles.title: India's 'golden boy' Neeraj Chopra's stellar 2025: From touching 90 m mark to heartbreaking 26-event streak end
articles.summary: India's ace javelin thrower Neeraj Chopra, an Olympic medalist and former world champion, concluded his extraordinary 26-event streak of top-two podium finishes. This marks a significant moment for the national sporting icon, ending a remarkable period of consistent excellence in his illustrious career. His unprecedented run showcased unparalleled dedication and performance at the highest level, inspiring aspirants nationwide to strive for similar consistency.

articles.title: BoG exempts informal cross-border traders from LOC requirement
articles.summary: The Bank of Ghana has exempted informal cross-border traders from needing a Letter of Commitment (LOC). This aims to ease regulatory burdens for small-scale merchants, simplifying trade processes and potentially fostering economic activity within the informal sector. The central bank issued new guidelines to govern this exemption, impacting national trade and financial inclusion for numerous local traders.

articles.title: From camouflage software to tank decoys, DRDO boosts Army’s concealment playbook following Op Sindoor
articles.summary: India is significantly strengthening battlefield concealment strategies, recognizing deception's critical role in modern warfare. This proactive measure follows recent hostilities with Pakistan, which underscored the escalating threat from advanced missiles. By enhancing its ability to hide assets and personnel, India aims to improve survivability and operational effectiveness, ensuring forces remain less detectable and more resilient against modern adversaries.

articles.title: Top Trump official melts down with vulgar attack on MAGA influencers
articles.summary: Harmeet Dhillon, an Assistant Attorney General for Civil Rights at the U.S. Justice Department, reportedly launched a vulgar tirade. She targeted MAGA influencers who had criticized the Trump administration. This incident reveals internal tensions and disagreements within segments of the Republican sphere regarding support for the former president, drawing attention to conduct within political circles and the Justice Department.

articles.title: Inside world's ultimate X-ray machine before it becomes more powerful
articles.summary: SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory is developing its LCLS-II X-ray laser, a complex system featuring an electron beam traveling through a niobium cavity. This critical component helps generate powerful X-ray pulses, essential for cutting-edge scientific research in diverse fields. The Klystron Gallery houses key infrastructure supporting this advanced technological endeavor.

articles.title: Raiders NFL Draft order 2026: Where Las Vegas stands after Week 17 vs. NY Giants
articles.summary: The Las Vegas Raiders strategically lost their Week 17 NFL game against the New York Giants, a calculated move dubbed the "Tank Bowl." This defeat secured them the coveted No. 1 overall pick for the 2026 NFL draft. This illustrates the long-term strategic planning in professional sports, where teams prioritize future talent acquisition and team rebuilding over immediate game results, showcasing competitive foresight.

articles.title: "Will help in enhancing operational capabilities": Rajnath Singh after DAC approves proposals worth Rs 79,000 crore
articles.summary: The Defence Acquisition Council (DAC) recently granted Acceptance of Necessity (AoN) for diverse proposals from the Armed Forces. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh subsequently underscored the Ministry's commitment to these initiatives. This crucial approval initiates the procurement process, essential for modernizing India's military capabilities and bolstering national defence, reflecting strategic intent in defence preparedness.
